source: Independent planned one-position streams of A_CORE, B_STATE, P18 and W024A.
algorithm: Sort by decision_time and benchmark name. Remove expired planned intervals before each decision. Admit an event when active planned positions are below the cap. Same-decision ties use lexical benchmark order only for deterministic counting.
purpose: Measure how much structural count can be retained with bounded simultaneous exposure. This does not authorize a runtime or risk change.
